title: Komyo-ji — The Autumn Bell
description: A vermilion Buddhist temple above a koi pond: a three-storey pagoda with a nine-ring sorin, an irimoya worship hall and its golden Buddha, an arched pilgrimage bridge, gravel courts, and a suspended bronze bell beside the autumn maple.
